title: Parallel corpus: Aruban Papiamento translations of the prompts

fields.name: prompt_id
fields.description: The prompt this translates (prompts.tsv in the same folder)

fields.name: pap
fields.description: The Aruban Papiamento sentence, as written by a person. Several rows may share a prompt_id: there can be more than one good translation.

fields.name: translated_by
fields.description: Contributor handle(s) of the person who wrote the sentence, from _meta/contributors.tsv. Never machine: the tool shows no machine draft.

fields.name: checked_by
fields.description: Contributor handles of the other teachers who rated the sentence good, separated by '; '. At least one before a board member may set reviewed.

fields.name: fix_of
fields.description: Id of the row this one corrects, when a rater proposed a fix

fields.name: flags_kept
fields.description: Rule ids (rules/rules.jsonl) or lexicon ids (bar-, var-) the live checker raised and the writer kept on purpose, separated by '; '. Shows the board what to look at, and measures checker precision.

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the review-board members who confirmed the row, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed. Never machine.

$comment: PROPOSAL, not in _meta/schema/ yet. For corpus/parallel/pairs.tsv and eval/parallel/pairs.tsv. pap gets the validator's Aruban spelling checks. No source/page: a contributed sentence has no printed page; translated_by and the contribution batch in notes are its provenance. This needs an exception in _meta/conventions.md ('every row cites a source and a page'). A pair always lives in the same folder (corpus/ or eval/) as its prompt.
